samples.xml_description:
<module id="adder_pipe_64bit">
    <description>64-bit ripple carry adder with pipelining stages.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="i_en">Enable signal for addition operation.</input>
        <input id="adda" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="addb" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand B.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[64:0]">65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb.</output>
        <output id="o_en">Output enable signal indicating the availability of the result.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter name="ADD">Addition state.</parameter>
        <parameter name="RESULT">Result state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state" width="2">Current state of the FSM.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width="2">Next state of the FSM.</reg>
        <reg id="enable_reg" width="1">Register to hold the enable signal.</reg>
        <reg id="adda_reg" width_description="[63:0]">Register to hold the first input operand.</reg>
        <reg id="addb_reg" width_description="[63:0]">Register to hold the second input operand.</reg>
        <reg id="carry_out_reg" width="1">Register to hold the carry out signal.</reg>
        <wire id="sum" width_description="[63:0]">Sum of adda and addb.</wire>
        <wire id="carry_in" width="1">Carry in signal for the next stage.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                current_state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
            end
        end

        always @(*) begin
            case (current_state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (i_en) begin
                        next_state = ADD;
                        enable_reg = 1;
                        adda_reg = adda;
                        addb_reg = addb;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                        enable_reg = 0;
                    end
                end
                ADD: begin
                    next_state = RESULT;
                    sum = adda_reg + addb_reg + carry_out_reg;
                    carry_in = sum[63];
                end
                RESULT: begin
                    next_state = IDLE;
                    carry_out_reg = carry_in;
                end
                default: begin
                    next_state = IDLE;
                end
            endcase
        end

        // Output logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                o_en <= 0;
                result <= 65'b0;
            end else begin
                if (current_state == RESULT && enable_reg) begin
                    o_en <= 1;
                    result <= {carry_out_reg, sum};
                end else begin
                    o_en <= 0;
                    result <= 65'b0;
                end
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
